## Today’s injury briefing

- **Mike Evans — ruled out for Sunday**
  - Kyle Shanahan said Evans is **going in the right direction**, but the team wants the injury to **fully heal** so it doesn’t flare up again.
  - **Why it matters:** Tampa Bay loses a major receiving threat; fantasy managers need a replacement plan.
  - **Watch next:** No return timeline was specified.

- **Packers injury report vs. Minnesota**
  - Green Bay listed **seven players questionable**, including **DE Lukas Van Ness, S Xavier McKinney, S Javon Bullard, and G Kevin Zeitzer**.
  - The Packers also **ruled out four players**; their names were not specified.
  - **LB Zaire Franklin** is listed as **doubtful**.
  - **Why it matters:** Multiple question marks in the secondary and along the line could affect both defensive stability and protection.
  - **Watch next:** Final inactive list on Sunday.

- **Titans vs. Jaguars — multiple starters ruled out**
  - Tennessee ruled out **WR Carnell Tate (shoulder)**, **LG Peter Skoronski (hamstring)**, **P Tommy Townsend (left knee)**, **LB Cody Barton (concussion)**, and **LB Anthony Hill Jr. (neck)**.
  - **Why it matters:** That’s a notable hit to the Titans’ offense, protection, special teams, and defense.
  - **Watch next:** No returners were specified in this update.

- **Ravens QB Lamar Jackson — out 6-10 weeks**
  - Jackson is expected to miss **6 to 10 weeks** after **thumb surgery**.
  - **Why it matters:** Huge loss for Baltimore’s offense and a major fantasy shakeup at quarterback.
  - **Watch next:** His recovery timeline and when Baltimore can expect him back.

**Returning from injury:** No player was specifically announced as returning today.
